text: dsh-wordcraft 把 WordCraft 文档编辑器接入 DeepSeek Harness，在右侧侧栏中打开可交互的 DOCX 编辑面板，并通过 MCP 工具让 agent 与面板共享同一编辑会话。它注册编辑指导 skill 和 wordcraft-editor MCP 服务，可创建或打开文档、运行编辑命令、批量执行操作、查看编辑器连接状态并保存导出文件。适合需要在聊天旁撰写、修改和检查 Word 文档的 DSH 用户；需要 Node.js 24 及支持的 DSH 版本，并启用 Web 侧栏浏览器。

dsh-wordcraft brings a live WordCraft editor beside DSH chat. Its MCP server shares one session between agent and sidebar, with tools to open documents, edit them, check status, and save files. For users drafting Word documents in DSH. Requires Node.js 24+, DSH, and the Web sidebar browser.
想在 DSH 聊天旁边直接编辑 DOCX 文档
帮我把 Word 文档打开到侧栏里，并让 agent 和编辑器同步操作
需要让 DSH 创建文档并调用编辑命令排版
我想批量执行 Word 文档里的格式和编辑操作
怎么在 DSH 里检查编辑器面板是否已经连接
I want to edit a Word document beside my DSH chat.
Can my agent and the document editor share one live session?
I need DSH to create documents and run Word editing commands.
dsh-wordcraft 的功能「侧栏编辑器」：在 DSH 中打开 WordCraft 编辑器，并返回本机侧栏页面链接；agent 与面板连接到同一编辑会话。首次打开可指定工作区和文件。
dsh-wordcraft 的功能「文档操作」：通过 MCP 提供的工具创建、打开文档，并运行单条或批量编辑命令；工具列表包含 WordCraft 的文档操作能力。
dsh-wordcraft 的功能「导出保存」：接收编辑器导出的文件并写入当前工作区的 craft-exports 目录；也可通过 save_document 将文档保存到指定路径。
dsh-wordcraft 使用前须知：首次打开编辑器后，一个 MCP 实例绑定到选定工作区；切换工作区需要重启 DSH。Web 侧栏导出文件写入该工作区的 craft-exports 目录。

dsh-wordcraft README · dsh-wordcraft：**WordCraft editor panel for DeepSeek Harness** — open a real, editable Word document in DSH's right Sidebar Browser and watch the agent edit it live, in the same editor session.

> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with DeepSeek or the WordCraft/ArtCraft teams.

dsh-wordcraft README · What it does：- Registers one general `wordcraft-editor` skill for the parts an agent gets wrong unprompted: panel handoff and attachment, editor-session and cursor semantics, Word layout checks (sections, TOC/caption fields, tables, pagination) and save/verify rules. No scenario writing templates.
- Starts one stdio MCP server, `wordcraft-editor`, over a bundled WordCraft runtime — no download at first use.
- Serves the editor panel over a loopback HTTP URL with a random token. Click the link the agent prints: DSH opens it in the right Sidebar Browser.
- Keeps the panel and the agent on **one editor session**: `editor_status.attached` turns true once the page is loaded, and every `type_text` / `execute` call shows up in the panel immediately.

dsh-wordcraft README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared through `engines.dsh`).
- Node.js 24 or newer (the bundled editor runtime requires it).
- The right Sidebar Browser enabled in your Web profile (DSH ships it disabled for Web; see below).

dsh-wordcraft README · Install：From GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lu123bing/dsh-wordcraft
```

Enable the right Sidebar Browser (one-time, in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: ui-sidebar-browser
  disabled: false
```

Restart DSH, then ask in a new session:

> 用 WordCraft 打开编辑器，帮我把这份周报整理成 DOCX。

dsh-wordcraft README · Install：The agent calls `open_browser_editor`, prints a `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<token>/` link, and waits until `editor_status` reports `attached: true` (usually 8–20 seconds). Click the link — the editor opens beside the chat and shares the agent's session.

If clicking the link opens a browser tab instead of the sidebar, set **Settings → General → link opening → In-App Sidebar**.

dsh-wordcraft README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-wordcraft
```

Remove the `ui-sidebar-browser` entry again if you no longer want the browser panel.

dsh-wordcraft README · How it works：1. `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the skill provider (`lib/index.js`) and one MCP client row (`wordcraft-editor` → `ui/bootstrap.mjs`).
2. `ui/bootstrap.mjs` verifies the bundled runtime against `ui/runtime.lock.json` (45 pinned files) and starts the editor adapter.
3. The adapter (`src/adapter.mjs`, bundled to `ui/dist/adapter.mjs`) exposes the editor's MCP tools and a loopback browser page. The panel talks to the adapter through the same MCP session the agent uses, which is why edits are shared rather than copied.
4. Every editor asset is served through chunked MCP resources (2 MiB per chunk); the panel runs as WebAssembly.

dsh-wordcraft README · Security and limits：- One workspace per MCP instance: the first `open_editor` call binds the workspace; switching requires restarting DSH. Paths outside the workspace are rejected.
- The loopback page uses a random token and `Host`/`Origin` checks; no Node.js APIs are exposed to the page. The runtime is verified by SHA-256 before it runs and is never downloaded at runtime.
- The project bundles a pinned, prebuilt editor runtime; the panel UI has no network access (`connect-src 'none'`).
- Web sidebar iframes do not have the download permission: exports made inside the panel are written to `<workspace>/craft-exports/`; prefer `save_document` for deliverables.
- WordCraft's native CLI and the editor panel are separate sessions; save and reopen before switching.

dsh-wordcraft README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build:ui   # rebuild ui/dist/adapter.mjs and ui/dist/host.js from src/
npm test           # manifest, runtime lock, MCP handshake, source-cleanliness tests
```

The prebuilt WordCraft editor binary under `ui/dist/editor/` is a pinned artifact: run `node scripts/update-runtime-lock.mjs` after an intentional change and keep `ui/runtime.lock.json` in sync (`npm test` reports mismatches).
